title: A mixture can be separated by a physical change such as evaporating
summary: A mixture is two or more kinds of matter that can be present in different amounts and pulled apart by a physical change such as evaporation.
body: OpenStax Chemistry says a mixture is two or more types of matter. The amounts can vary, and the parts can be separated by physical changes. Evaporation is the physical change the page names. That is different from breaking a compound, which needs a chemical change and makes new substances. The page does not walk through a still or a filter step by step. It only marks drying the liquid off as one physical way to separate a mixture. Uneven salad dressing is a different card.
